headline: Ramayana peaks at 48.9K tickets expected 8–9 PM; all three films trail yesterday on a Diwali Sunday.
bullets: Ramayana could reach about 1.01M tickets today (range 970K to 1.06M), with the 8–9 PM hour expected at 48.9K (range 42.7K to 54.8K), though it is -32% vs yesterday.
Ramayana is in its opening weekend (release day 3), and its forecast is nudged up by 16%, mainly from its BookMyShow rating (+6%), word of mouth (+5%), IMDb (+3%) and critics (+2%).
Monday 9 Nov is a weekday, not a strong day, so Ramayana is expected at 612K tickets tomorrow (range 448K to 820K).

Aadarsha Kutumbam peaks at 1.1K in 8–9 PM (range 993 to 1.3K) and Jailer 2 at 931 (range 812 to 1K), both down vs yesterday by -35% and -23%; neither has review signals, so their forecasts are unadjusted.
watch: Diwali is listed for today (2026-11-08), and festive timing could push evening sales outside these ranges.
Ramayana's review and word-of-mouth signals are early and untested, so a shift in ratings could move its figures by up to about +16%.
